contact_name.value: Dr. Amy Fagan, Director of Health

services.value: The laboratory provides clinical and environmental testing to support the Wichita Falls-Wichita County Public Health District in-house operations, including testing for blood, serum, urine, and other body fluids for services such as STI Clinic, Disease Intervention Services (DIS), and the HIV Program. It also supports Environmental Health Division sampling including aquatic facility water samples and other samples in public health response such as processing food samples or surface swabs, with analysis of food, water, and soft serve ice cream samples.
